jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - SDK and Visualization Engines
jobs.description:
Map Visualization builds the technology that turns map data into what people actually see - satellite imagery, buildings, roads, and live map content - across mobile devices and in-car systems. The Visualization Engines team owns the rendering engines behind it: a Unity-based 3D map renderer and an in-house C++ rendering engine, both shipping to phones and to automotive customers.  
  
We are looking for an engineer to strengthen our rendering and computer graphics expertise while staying comfortable contributing to the mobile SDK layer around it.  
  
**What you will do**

* Design technical solutions to complex problems at scale: large map scenes, tight frame budgets, constrained mobile and automotive hardware.

* Work across the rendering stack: from the C# and mobile APIs our SDK consumers use down to the graphics pipeline and shader-level work.

* Take ownership of your area and lead changes within the team.

* Build iteratively using agile methods.

* Work with AI as a standard part of engineering practice - we use it heavily and expect you to.

**What you will need**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, and 3+ years of equivalent experience in at least one modern programming language.

* Strong C++ or C# or Kotlin or Swift - we expect you are genuinely productive in at least one of them.

* Comfortable contributing to the mobile SDK layer

* Knowledge and practice of professional software engineering across the full development lifecycle: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing, and operations.

* Comfortable communicating in English, written and spoken.

**One of these two profiles is you**  
  
Beyond the essentials above, we need one of these two backgrounds. We are deliberately flexible about which: we will trade depth in one area for the appetite to grow in the other, so you need one profile, not both.  
  
Profile A (the mobile engineer).  
You are a strong Android and/or iOS engineer, and you want to move toward rendering and computer graphics.  
  
Profile B (the graphics engineer).  
You work in computer graphics, rendering engines, or visualization, and you are interested in learning mobile platform development.  
  
**Nice to have**

* Unity engine and/or APIs: Vulkan, OpenGL, ...

* Shader authoring and graphics pipeline optimization.

* Kotlin and/or Swift - both are in use in our SDK and demo applications.

* Automotive software.

* Working with large geospatial or other large-scale datasets.

**What you get**  
  
You learn AI while doing your actual job: We use AI heavily in day-to-day engineering, and you get access to current frontier models. Working here means building that skill on real production work - paid, in working hours, not as a side project after them.  
  
A stack that is broad and you can move around inside it: Rendering and graphics engineering, mobile development on both Android and iOS, automotive software, cloud-connected visualization systems. The point is not just that all of it exists here but that moving from one to another is normal and easy. Whichever profile you come from, the expectation is that over time you pick up the other side too, alongside colleagues already working in it.  
  
Work that really uses what you know: Rendering maps at scale, finding performance inside a frame budget, processing large volumes of geospatial data, delivering it on mobile and automotive hardware. It is the kind of engineering where your existing knowledge is in play and there is a steady supply of challenging problems worth thinking about.  
  
Work you can point at: What you build becomes visible as beautiful maps used by end users and by our automotive customers.  
  
Interested but not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway - good motivation carries lot of weight here.

**What we offer**

  

A competitive compensation package, of course.

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.

  

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance.

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday.

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom!

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location.

**Meet your team**

We are the Map Visualization Product Unit. We develop map rendering technology that can be integrated into navigation systems and location-based applications, providing our technology to our customers in the form of cloud-based APIs and SDKs.

We see quality-management processes as a source of competitive advantage. As part of our product-led and outcome-oriented culture, we believe it is crucial to have mechanisms in place to measure and improve the quality of our products in a continuous manner so we can achieve our mission of mapping the world in real time.

**At TomTom...**

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

Work with a team of 3,300+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.

**After you apply**

Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.

**TomTom is an equal opportunity employer**

TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, *you*. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Manager (Engineering), Digital Innovation Studio
jobs.description:
Institution: Tan Tock Seng Hospital

Family Group: Administration

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

  

**Job Title:**

Manager (Engineering), Digital Innovation Studio

**NHG Vision: Adding years of healthy life**

  

**CHI Mission: Driving innovation for systems change**

  

The Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) is committed to catalysing and driving innovation for systems change in healthcare, thereby adding years of healthy life. Built on the foundation of co-learning and collaboration, CHI’s core is in facilitating innovation through its suite of platforms and programmes. CHI has built a dynamic network of local and international partners who are dedicated to fostering innovation, creating thought leadership, co-building initiatives to inculcate and embed a culture of innovation within healthcare. We spearhead innovation by driving the adoption of the CHI Innovation Cycle, care and process redesign and in the use of technology. CHI leads transformation at the care, systems and ecosystem levels to achieve better health and healthcare.

  

**About the Digital Innovation Office (DIO)**

  

The Digital Innovation Office (DIO) under the Centre for Healthcare Innovation (CHI) drives NHG Health’s digital transformation across three key platforms: Digital Hospital, Digital Community, and Health Empowered by AI Launchpad (HEAL).

DIO’s mission is to enable transformation and deliver impact by supporting institution-led platforms that advance workforce and care transformation. Through collaborative programmes and partnerships, DIO serves as a catalyst for AI adoption at scale and digital innovation across hospitals and community care.

**JOB SUMMARY**

  

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Digital Innovation Studio (DIS), the role will manage DIS’s proof-of-concept (POC) platforms consisting of multi-cloud sandbox environments and maintain full technical understanding of their AI and/or IT standards. The candidate will undertake important technical activities together with NHG project teams for the robust prototyping of digital solutions that support CHI’s digital and AI-enabled future.

  

In addition, the candidate will participate in user-engaged product iteration, and technology ecosystem stewardship—working closely with clinicians, operations teams, UX specialists, data scientists, and industry partners.

**MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

1. **Technical Prototype Engineering**

* Design and support the development of lightweight prototypes, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, and workflow components.
* Collaborate with project teams to define technical requirements and translate business needs into implementable solution designs, ensuring alignment with security and scalability considerations.
* Develop technical documentation such as PRDs that include human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflow and guardrail/safety mechanisms, and architecture diagrams.
* Provide hands-on support for prototype development, testing, and technical troubleshooting.

**2. Sandbox Platform Management**
----------------------------------

* Maintain DIS multi-cloud sandbox environments across AWS, Azure and/or GCP, including user onboarding, resource provisioning, and access management .
* Manage and optimise additional enterprise prototyping platforms, ensuring users can effectively build solutions using pre-established services and reusable architecture patterns.
* Engage industry cloud providers and healthcare IT vendors to stay abreast of emerging platforms, integration approaches, and capabilities, and advise project teams on designing prototypes aligned with target deployment environments.
  

**3. Administrative support**

* Support DIS in secretariat or administrative work where needed.
* Design and deliver hands-on training workshops on modern software development practices and the effective use of cloud-based tools and platforms.
  

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

  

(A) EDUCATION, TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
* 5 years hands-on engineering experience (front-end or back-end in cloud environment).
* Ability to build and iterate prototypes using both traditional development stacks (e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, .NET) and low-code/no-code tools within enterprise security constraints.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS preferred), containerized deployments, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Proficient in drafting PRDs and creating pragmatic lightweight solution architectures to guide technical implementation
  

**Desired Skills**

* Passion for healthcare and to create new solutions that can benefit patients or hospital systems.
* Experience working in healthcare, or with standards such as HL7/FHIR, is advantageous.
* Understanding of cybersecurity principles, data protection, and safe experimentation in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with vendors or external tech partners is a bonus.
* Flexible mindset to adopt new platforms and create new technical frameworks or processes in our evolving environment

jobs.title: Project Controls Engineer - Risk Management
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.  
Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives.

Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success. Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.  
Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

 **Job Description**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Risk Management Engineer or Project Controls Engineer with risk management experience to join our organization in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and mitigating project risks while maintaining robust project controls across multiple initiatives. You will work collaboratively with project teams, stakeholders, and senior management to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong organizational skills, technical proficiency, and the ability to communicate complex risk and control information effectively to diverse audiences.

* Acting as the Risk facilitator for a large aviation/ airport project.
* Implementing the Risk Management Plan and supporting project teams in applying the risk management process.
* Facilitating risk workshops with project stakeholders.
* Maintaining risk registers and ensuring risks and associated actions are updated accordingly.
* Preparing monthly and ad hoc risk reports.
* Undertaking ad hoc Quantitative Risk Assessments (QRAs), where required, outside of the formal Risk Management Plan and delivery governance framework.
* Maintaining a strong focus on risk mitigation plans and proactively following up with action owners to ensure timely completion of agreed actions.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 3 - 5+ years of experience in risk management, project controls, or related project management discipline
* Demonstrated expertise in risk identification, assessment, and mitigation planning
* Proficiency in project management software and tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent)
* Experience developing and maintaining risk registers and control documentation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present findings to senior stakeholders
* Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix environment and collaborate across multiple project teams
* Background in construction, engineering, or infrastructure project delivery or planning / project controls functions within a PMC/PMO environment is desired

  
**Additional Information**

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

jobs.title: MCP Expert (Java API Integration)
jobs.description:
MCP Expert (Java API Integration) Amsterdam

Hybrid | 12-Month Contract (Extendable) | Rate: Negotiable

Get in on the ground floor of enterprise AI integration.

Our client is building the platform that connects AI agents to real enterprise systems and they need an MCP expert who's already done this in production, not just in a proof of concept. This is a genuinely rare opportunity: MCP is brand new, production deployments are scarce, and this role puts you at the center of a Central Platform Team shaping how AI agents talk to Java-based enterprise APIs at scale.
If you've built MCP servers that actually run in production not just demos this is your next move.

The Role

You'll design, build and own the integration layer connecting AI agents and LLM-based applications to enterprise Java APIs via MCP. You'll work the full delivery lifecycle Dev, UAT, production on Azure, with real ownership and real influence over how the organization adopts MCP going forward.

What You'll Do

Design, build and maintain MCP servers and tool integrations exposing enterprise Java APIs to AI agents and LLM applications
Develop and integrate Java REST APIs within MCP-based architectures on the central platform
Own integrations across dev, UAT and production - robust, monitored, genuinely production-grade
Deploy and operate on Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, API Management, Azure Open AI / AI Foundry)
Partner with platform, architecture and product teams to define MCP standards and best practice across the organization
Take point on troubleshooting, production support and incident resolution
Shape documentation, testing strategy and release process from the ground up

What You Bring

Proven, hands-on MCP experience you've built MCP servers, tools and integrations, not just read the spec
Strong Java development background with real REST API design and integration experience
Solid Microsoft Azure experience deploying, configuring and running services in production
Comfort across the full dev UAT production lifecycle, including live support
Able to work from Amsterdam 2 days a week
Strong English communication skills

Nice to Have

Azure Open AI, Azure AI Foundry, or agentic AI framework experience
APIM, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD via Azure DevOps
Background on central platform or shared-services teams
Dutch language skills

What's On Offer

12-month contract with strong potential to extend
Rate fully negotiable bring your number
Hybrid working: just 2 days a week on-site in Amsterdam
A front-row seat at the center of the organization's AI and integration strategy the kind of role that looks very good on a CV in 12 months' time

Darwin Recruitment is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Your role at Dynatrace

As a Dynatrace Solution Engineer, you will be a key member of the Dynatrace sales engine and will be responsible for providing excellent technical support to the sales team. You will be the expert on Dynatrace and all facets of Advanced Observability. Within this exciting role, you will be responsible for executing great demos which demonstrate the Dynatrace unique approach in solving the customer’s pain, executing and managing POCs onsite and remote, building key relationships with Dynatrace’s customers and completing RFIs & RFPs. You will also work across teams including Dynatrace’s innovation labs, Dynatrace’s Expert Services consultants, CSMs and marketing.

About You

To ensure your success as a Solution Engineer at Dynatrace, you need to be an ambitious, confident and self-motivated individual, with previous SE experience or another technical customer facing role. You need to be passionate about innovative technology, technical sales and articulating value to customers and prospects. In addition, we are also looking for:

An excellent team player, with the ability to work across all disciplines.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical value into business value.
Previous 3 – 5 years of experience with observability or application performance management technologies and techniques.
Ability to troubleshoot technical issues to produce a working outcome and be able to manage this process.
Ability to manage a number of projects simultaneously, work with a number of different sales people and support other SEs where needed.
Must have a strong desire to grow professionally, adapt to an ever-changing environment and are coachable.
Must be able to travel up to 30% of the time

Responsibilities

Evangelize Dynatrace’s product offerings during international trade shows and at key customer account meetings to promote new and expanded business.
Partner with sales representatives to identify new sales opportunities as well as incremental sales opportunities within existing accounts.
As part of the solution engineering team participate in proof of concept (PoC) creation and cloud architecture discussions, leading the technical solution evaluation portion in support of sales opportunities either directly or through channel partners for multiple POCs.
Present Dynatrace’s vision to our customers C-suite executives.
Provide technical guidance in the Discovery, Solution Evaluation, and Solution Proposal stages of the opportunity sales cycle.
Present on-stage demonstrations providing insight and context to our customers during key marketing events. Either at Dynatrace sponsored industry events or partner sponsored events, ensure key demonstrations are delivered by you or a team member at demonstration booths.
Gather, qualify and provide feedback from customers to Product Management to improve Dynatrace’s market share and meet the market needs.
Not only work with internal sales team, but also with partners, supporting their team in the customers and being a technical point of contact for them (trusted advisor/technical coach).
Position might be filled at a higher level based on candidate experience.

What Will Help You Succeed

How you (and your Recruiter!) will know that you are a good fit:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent education or experience required.
3 years of experience within the observability space.
Fluent in Dutch
Experience with web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Experience with programming / scripting side technologies such as Java, .NET, PHP, Go, Node.js and database.
Advance knowledge of Operating Systems (OS) including Windows and Linux.
Experience with DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering practices Knowledge with cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure or GCP.
Experience with modern technologies like containers, Kubernetes / OpenShift, Serverless functions, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with automation like Ansible, Puppet, Terraform, etc.

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.
